# SQL in 40 hours

- The user's words decide; the newest wins. Confirm only before deleting the repo or publishing a secret.
- Every number has a source or a stated assumption; counts and hours come from `python checks/check.py`.
- Count what exists before saying what is left.
- Crew: one writer, one reviewer on a stronger model. Each writer works in its own worktree.
- Retro after every job into `docs/learnings.md`.
